name: terraform_pad
description: Building pad (建筑台地): a flat platform at target height blended into the surrounding ground by a smoothstep transition band (<=16 blocks) with +-1 deterministic noise so the slope stays natural. 3 blocks of fill under every surface column.
when_to_use: Before any build on uneven terrain. Read the typical surrounding height from terrain.json / get_terrain_summary and pass it as `ground` — the script cannot read the world. Build on the pad afterwards.

origin.notes: min corner of the FLAT pad; y = pad surface height

ground.notes: REQUIRED: typical surrounding surface height from terrain.json

transition.notes: blend band width; clamped to 16 by spec

stone_material.notes: shows through on noise dips for variety
